This small plot near the house is just 0.08 hectares, and I plant it mixed with different things for my family to eat — it is not my main cashew field. Here in Mtwara the sandy soil is tired, but fertilizer costs too much for a small mixed plot like this, so I will not buy any. I keep our chicken droppings and some kitchen waste and scatter it on this plot, and my wife and I will do the weeding ourselves with the jembe. The seeds I save from last year are good enough for this little garden plot.
